sections.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.subheadline: Clarity on our processes, scheduling, and garment safety.

faqs.question: What kind of cleaning solvents do you utilize?
faqs.answer: We strictly use advanced, eco-conscious hydrocarbon solvents. They provide superior lifting power for oils and stains but remain completely gentle on your clothes and leave zero lingering chemical odor.

faqs.question: How does the home pickup service work?
faqs.answer: Simply schedule a window via our portal. Place your garments in the provided protective bag at your designated drop point. We process your items and return them perfectly pressed within 48 hours.

faqs.question: Do you provide professional alterations?
faqs.answer: Yes. We maintain an expert tailor on-site capable of handling everything from precise simple hems to complex structural adjustments on tailored jackets.

faqs.question: Can you safely restore vintage garments?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every vintage piece undergoes a manual structural assessment before cleaning. We select the least aggressive, safest protocol to restore vibrancy while preserving aged fibers.
